title: When Faith Meets Opportunity
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful story of faith and perseverance, highlighting how God's timing and provision brought a family from a season of struggle to a moment of breakthrough and triumph. In this inspiring sermon, Pastor Chris shares the remarkable journey of a family's home-buying experience, demonstrating how God's faithfulness and guidance can be seen in even the smallest details. Don't miss this encouraging message that will leave you in awe of God's goodness and sovereignty.
